design_rationale:
WORKLOG / DOSSIER - task 1 (card_billing_and_disputes, env_0061). Step 0 draw (scripts/draw_counts.py --task 1): {"prerequisite_problems": 2, "factor_counts": [4, 4, 6]}; card_ext_courtesy_credit takes 6, card_ext_missing_credit_notice 4, card_ext_catch_up_payment 4.
SCOPE SNAPSHOT. Occupied by task 0: card_ext_credit_line_review (raise_credit_line_b8050b6c) and card_ext_double_posting_notice (file_double_posting_notice_03ed3b71, duplicate_charge). Claimed here: card_ext_courtesy_credit (card_fee_reversal, grant_courtesy_credit_38b9fa68), card_ext_missing_credit_notice (card_dispute_filed credit_not_posted, file_missing_credit_notice_85b33449, owner user) and card_ext_catch_up_payment (card_payment, take_phone_payment_161e7e24). No later task remains (M=2); together the two tasks cover all five extended policies, pairwise disjoint in policies, tools and computed quantities. The two notice tools are told apart by reason (duplicate charge vs credit not posted), so each state-form prerequisite sentence names a state exactly one write produces.
WHY A GOOD TEST. The cardmember asks only to have a 32.00 late fee taken off. The courtesy policy waits on two record states that do not hold: an unreturned payment after the missed due date covering the missed minimum (the only such payment, 40.00 on 2026-09-20, came back unpaid on 2026-09-23), and an open credit-not-posted dispute for the store refund that reached the card only in part (612.40 refunded by the store on 2026-08-20, 250.00 credited). The catch-up payment itself waits on that dispute, because a payment never needs to cover an amount under open billing dispute. The agent must discover the shortfall from store and card records, compute the notice amount with its related interest, hand the notice to the cardmember, size the catch-up payment (coverage, recomputed minimum, special-financing installment, returned-payment add-back), take it, and only then compute the partial courtesy credit from six factors.
PROBLEM-TREE CARD. Root card_ext_courtesy_credit. Edges: (1) courtesy -> card_ext_catch_up_payment, value_input on ct_cured, state form, negated direction: 'The courtesy credit is not granted until the most recent payment credited after the missed payment due date stands unreturned at no less than the minimum payment due that was missed.' (a courtesy desk tells a cardmember a credit 'is not granted until' the account is caught up). Exactly one write of this difficulty credits a payment: the catch-up phone payment. (2) courtesy -> card_ext_missing_credit_notice, value_input on ct_open_disputed, state form, affirmative: 'The courtesy credit is worked out only after the cardmember's most recent Marlowe & Finch refund settled to the card tender, when its card credits fall short of it, carries an open credit-not-posted dispute on the refunded purchase.' (3) catch-up -> notice, value_input on cu_open_disputed, state form, negated: 'The catch-up amount is not set until the cardmember's most recent Marlowe & Finch refund to the card tender, if it lacks its full card credit, is under an open credit-not-posted dispute.' Exactly one write opens a credit-not-posted dispute: the missing-credit notice (the task-0 notice records duplicate_charge). Four-point test holds for each: ordering connective (not ... until / only after), record-visible state (a payment row and its return status; a dispute row by reason), no tool/id/code token, scope matching condition. Derivation: sentence + ledger (returned payment; partial credit vs store refund) + the depended-on rules (the notice opens the dispute; the phone payment credits a payment) -> one resolving action each. Topological order: notice (step 11), payment (step 13), courtesy (step 15). Deletion sensitivity (actual runs): no payment -> courtesy 0.00; no notice -> payment 232.17 and courtesy 18.88; gold 228.47 / 28.48. user_scenario never mentions disputes, refunds or payments unless the representative raises them. Tools validate nothing.
BASE-INVARIANT CARD. Step 9 card_billing_dispute: notice_within_window (first statement showing the coat posting 2026-08-18; day 1 = 2026-08-19, day 60 = 2026-10-17 inclusive; 2026-09-24 = day 37; 2026-10-18 would fail) and no_open_dispute_on_txn (no dispute row names the coat posting; the 2025 filing on the 2025-10-11 purchase was withdrawn). Step 11 card_evt_payment_crediting (no structured gate): active account, phone_agent is a Store Card Elite channel, credited the same business day (Thursday 10:05 ET, before the 17:00 cut-off). Step 13 card_courtesy_fee_waiver: fee_not_already_reversed (only the 2025-11-13 fee was reversed before); courtesy allowance (Elite 2 per 12 months; one waiver 2025-11-20) and on-time statements (2026-02..2026-07 each paid between statement and due date) hold; the payment test is the overwritten one (single unreturned payment after the due date covering the missed minimum), met by the phone payment. card_account_closure is a governing policy of card_fee_reversal only through annual fee refunds on closure; not applicable (active account, no annual fee). OVERWRITES (card_ext_courtesy_credit, both on card_courtesy_fee_waiver): (a) 'A reversal always equals the full amount ...; partial reversals are not made.' -> courtesy reversals of late fees under this policy may be partial; every other reversal (assessed in error, annual fee refund) stays full; (b) 'and payments credited since the missed due date add up to at least the missed minimum payment due.' -> for these courtesy reversals the test is the most recent payment after the due date, unreturned, at least the missed minimum; the allowance and on-time tests stay in force. Both tails name their own scope and keep the still-in-force parts.
BUSINESS-OBJECT CARD. Notice: the most recent store refund settled to the card (order event OE refund 612.40, 2026-08-20, return of purchase 'Ralston Wool Wrap Coat', order 16954); the card posting of that order (612.40, posted 2026-07-27, period 2026-08) is the transaction named; card credits naming the refund: the 250.00 merchandise credit of 2026-08-24. Catch-up: missed statement = period of the most recent late fee (2026-08: minimum 40.00, due 2026-09-12); latest statement 2026-09 (2960.14, minimum 119.44, past due 40.00, due 2026-10-13, promo 1240.00); most recent payment after the due date = 40.00 on 2026-09-20, returned 2026-09-23. Courtesy: fee being reversed = the 2026-09-13 late fee 32.00; excluded: the 2025-11-13 fee (already courtesy-reversed), counted only as lateness history.
FACTOR CARD - notice (4): owed_comparison (parameter, cross-difficulty order; partial credit -> 362.40; baseline 612.40 -> result 625.89); missing_credit_interest_base (parameter; 49.84; baseline 0 -> 364.48); missing_credit_time_fraction (method, reads the store refund date: 29 days <= 30 -> fraction 29/30, billed 5.90; baseline fraction one -> 6.10 -> 370.58); missing_credit_accrual_days (method; from the statement date, 6 days -> 2.08; baseline zero days -> 368.30). Whole baseline 612.40.
FACTOR CARD - catch-up (4): coverage_follow (method; later statement due in 19 days -> that statement's minimum 119.44; baseline missed minimum -> 152.73); dispute_relief (method; 370.38 open -> relief 3.70, so 115.74; baseline zero relief -> 232.17); promo_paydown_addon (parameter; 11 months left -> 112.73; baseline 0 -> 115.74); returned_payment_addback (parameter; returned, no fee -> 40.00; baseline 0 -> 188.47). Whole baseline 0.00 (40.00 less the 40.00 payment).
FACTOR CARD - courtesy (6): tenure_share (parameter; 151 months -> 0.6; baseline 0.4 -> 22.08); courtesy_relationship_bonus (parameter, multi-source, cross-difficulty loyalty: Platinum AND 4544.15 of Marlowe & Finch card purchases dated fewer than 12 full calendar months before 2026-09-24 -> 0.15; baseline 0 -> 23.68); dispute_allowance (parameter; 370.38 >= 40.00 -> 0.3; baseline 0 -> 18.88); cure_speed (method; 12 days -> 0.09; baseline 0 -> 25.60; near-miss the returned 2026-09-20 payment); lateness_record (parameter; one other fee -> -0.15; baseline 0 -> 32.00 capped); prior_courtesy (parameter; waiver 10 months back -> -0.10; near-miss: not within 6; baseline 0 -> 31.68). Whole baseline 12.80.
SEED DESIGN. Statements 2025-10..2026-09 build the on-time run (2026-02..07), the missed 2026-08 statement and the later 2026-09 statement; payments show the run, the missed due date and the returned 2026-09-20 payment; the 2025-11 late fee and waiver feed lateness and prior-courtesy factors; the sectional of 2026-02-14 (deferred_interest_18, 1488.00) carries the promotional balance; the coat purchase/refund/partial credit and the order-side payment, refund and return records are the notice object (states the order charter produces: an in-store return received, refunded to the original card tender); the Platinum membership is the cross-difficulty tier; the withdrawn 2025 dispute (145.20 filed 2025-11-02, withdrawn 2025-11-10) nets to zero in the amount under open dispute and is the near-miss for the open-dispute reads. Automatic clauses: no restriction (one missed minimum only), no new late fee owed before 2026-10-13, no returned payment fee (late fee already assessed), the promotion ends on the payment due date of the statement closing 18 full months after 2026-02-14 (the 2027-08-18 statement, due 2027-09-12); the provisional-credit schedule does not apply to credit_not_posted disputes.
PERSONA. Delphine Okoro, polite but put out; volunteers only the late-fee request and her 12-year tenure; phone, ZIP and DOB on request; the coat return and the returned payment only if raised; submits the notice and authorizes the phone payment of whatever amount is quoted; ends on hearing the credit. No asks beyond the fee.
STANDARD SOLUTION. find_customers -> verify (phone + ZIP) -> account, transactions, statements, disputes, order events, purchase, return, loyalty -> notice 370.38 handed over (coat posting, period 2026-08) -> phone payment 228.47 -> courtesy reversal 28.48 of the 2026-09-13 fee.
DRAFT RECOMPUTATION from visible text: credit owed 612.40 - 250.00 = 362.40; base 49.84; 29-day proration -> 5.90; 6-day accrual -> 2.08; 370.38. Coverage: later statement due in 19 days -> (2960.14 - 370.38) x 1% + 49.84 = 75.74, relief 119.44 - 75.74 - 40.00 = 3.70, larger of 40.00 and 119.44 - 3.70 = 115.74; + 112.73 + 40.00 - 40.00 = 228.47. Share 0.6+0.15+0.3+0.09-0.15-0.10 = 0.89 -> 28.48. Agrees with gold.
VERIFICATION. Runnable entry point: .venv/bin/python skills/erl-task-instantiate/scripts/check_compute.py env/env_0061_department_store_chain/tasks/card_billing_and_disputes --task 1. Recorded output: notice step 11 -> 370.38 (factor baselines 625.89 / 364.48 / 370.58 / 368.30, all-baseline 612.40); catch-up step 13 -> 228.47 (152.73 / 232.17 / 115.74 / 188.47, all-baseline 0.00); courtesy step 15 -> 28.48 (22.08 / 23.68 / 18.88 / 25.60 / 32.00 / 31.68, all-baseline 12.80). Edge runs: catch-up without the notice 232.17; courtesy without the payment 0.00; courtesy without the notice 18.88. Per-task gates: EXTENDED OK, TASK TOOL CONTRACT OK, REPLAY OK (16 actions, closure 48/48), SOLVABILITY OK, COMPUTE OK, GROUNDING OK, SCOPE OK; traceability misses only the three task-tool names (KB not rendered).
REVISIONS. (1) Replay closure missed the purchase and return rows -> added find_purchases and find_return_requests reads (write steps moved to 11/13/15). (2) The no-open-dispute gate needs dispute-table evidence -> seeded the 2025 amount_incorrect dispute filed 2025-11-02 and withdrawn 2025-11-10 (nets to zero). (3) A step renumbering slip pointed the catch-up computation at step 15 -> corrected to 13.
REWORK r2. (a) Both prerequisite sentences on the missing-credit notice and their conditions now name the one object the notice resolves: the cardmember's most recent refund settled to the card tender, when its card credits fall short of it; the notice policy states that a fully credited refund or no refund is out of scope. (b) The cure adjustment tiers are all reachable once the payment test is met: a sliding bonus up to the fast-cure limit, a flat deduction past the slow-cure limit, none in between. (c) Window wording states 'fewer than N full calendar months before today', matching the rolling window computed. (d) The courtesy baseline sentence no longer restates the payment test. (e) Absent-record cases (no late fee, no refund) yield zero by rule and compute. (f) Stale statements corrected: the dispute table holds the withdrawn 2025 filing; the relationship spend is 4544.15; the promotion end is the due date of the 2027-08-18 statement.
REWORK r3 (render-source). Every factor now decides its quantity from its own reads: the missing-credit notice combines its billed and unbilled interest in the baseline from a time fraction and accrual days decided by the store refund date; the catch-up coverage now selects the latest statement's printed minimum, its past-due amount or the missed minimum, and a separate dispute relief is subtracted in the baseline, which never takes the catch-up below the missed minimum; compute_basis quotes re-checked verbatim. No scored value of this task moved.
CLOSURE. card_ext_missing_credit_notice -> file_missing_credit_notice_85b33449 -> disputed_amount step 11 = 370.38; card_ext_catch_up_payment -> take_phone_payment_161e7e24 -> amount step 13 = 228.47; card_ext_courtesy_credit -> grant_courtesy_credit_38b9fa68 -> amount step 15 = 28.48. Terminal state: credit_not_posted dispute row, a phone_agent payment row (period 2026-10), a courtesy_waiver reversal of 28.48 on the 2026-09-13 late fee, current balance 2960.14 - 228.47 - 28.48 = 2703.19. Difficulty closure: tasks 0 and 1 cover all five extended policies and five tools with no overlap.
user_scenario:
You are Delphine Okoro, 54, a high-school librarian in Chicago, calling customer care on your morning break. You are calm and polite but a little put out: your Marlowe & Finch Store Card Elite statement shows a $32 late fee, and you have had this card since 2014 and almost never pay late. You open with something like: "Hi, I'm calling about a late fee on my Marlowe & Finch card - I've been a cardmember for twelve years and I'm hoping you can take it off." You want the fee reversed on this call and you are fine with the representative doing whatever reversal they can for you. To be found you give your mobile number, 3125550183. If the representative asks to confirm your identity you give your billing ZIP code, 60626, and if they need one more detail your date of birth, 1971-11-05. You have only this one Marlowe & Finch card and a Finch Circle membership.
If the representative asks why the August payment was missed, you say only that you honestly thought that bill was taken care of. Only if the representative brings up your coat return do you explain: you returned a camel wool coat at the Old Orchard store on August 19 and were told the refund would go back on your card; you thought it would cover what you owed, and you have not checked how much of it actually came back. Only if the representative mentions the September 20 payment do you say you made it online from an old checking account and got an email a few days later that it did not go through.
If the representative explains that you need to give the bank notice about the refund yourself and sends you the notice form, you agree and submit it right away with exactly the details they give you. If the representative says a payment is needed to bring the account current, you authorize them to take a payment by phone today from the bank account on file for the amount they tell you is needed; you do not suggest an amount yourself and you do not know any balances or figures. You never ask about interest, refunds of other charges, or anything beyond the late fee.
Once the representative tells you how much of the late fee has been credited back, you thank them, say that is fair, and end the call; if asked whether there is anything else, you say no.
